notes.title: Really Simple Golf available now!
notes.notes:
[b]Really Simple Golf available now![/b]

The wait is over – Really Simple Golf is officially released on Steam! ⛳
You can now dive into the full adventure, watch the launch day developer stream, and grab it with a special 25% launch discount! 

Not sure yet? You can still try the free demo to see if it's your kind of challenge. 

I want to give a huge THANK YOU to everyone who supported the game along the way – your feedback, wishlists, and kind words meant the world. ❤️

And it is not the end. I’m planning to add new levels and new challenges, but I need YOUR feedback to make it even better.

Have fun playing 🏌️‍♂️

notes.title: Release this April! 🗓️⛳
notes.notes:
I’m so grateful for every single one of you who’s joined me on this journey. Your support means the world and keeps me motivated to make this game the best it can be. ❤️

I’m excited to officially announce that the game will be released this April! 🗓️⛳ Mark your calendars, because the adventure is just around the corner!

Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and maybe even some surprises along the way. 😉

Thank you all for being here – let’s keep growing together! 🚀

notes.title: New Trailer New Demo New newS ⛳
notes.notes:
Hi Golfers! ⛳

I’m super excited to kick off the new year by sharing the new trailer for the game.
Last year was full of hard work, but thankfully, it was incredibly fruitful! The first demo, a game teaser, a Steam festival, and even 500 wishlists! I’m so happy and immensely grateful to all of you! 🏌️‍♂️

But there’s no slowing down—I’m releasing a new trailer, a slightly improved demo, and soon I’ll be announcing the release date for the full version of the game! I can’t wait either!

For now, I can say that I’m already satisfied with the number of levels, gameplay time, and the game’s stability and performance, but I still want to polish a few things for you. :)

Expect the unexpected ⛳

~Lukudev

notes.title: A brand new tutorial with new items is available in the DEMO!
notes.notes:
Hello, hello, simple golfers!

I'm very happy that you got to play, and I still appreciate any feedback. It's invaluable to me!

I realized that many of you didn't fully understand the game's mechanics, so I made a Tutorial :). I hope it helps you understand the controls and rules of the game.

In short, to hit the ball, you just need to pull, aim, and release the mouse button or gamepad.
And only after the ball bounces off an obstacle can you hit it again.
Otherwise, you could keep bouncing the ball in the air all the way to the hole

That's all for the controls.

In the tutorial, you'll also find explanations about materials. Rocks, stone, wood, grass, metal, etc. The ball bounces differently off each material. Some materials are more bouncy, others less. Sand is the worst

My favorites are the sofas and other springy things

There are other moving obstacles and items too, but you'll discover them all in the full version :)

Ah! I almost forgot, hit the bottles in the tutorial, hehe.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
⛳️ Big News for Really Simple Golf ⛳️
[b]
Hey everyone![/b]

Just wanted to give you a quick update on all the hard work going on behind the scenes. 

[b]*Performance Upgrade! *[/b]

I've been optimizing the game to make sure it runs smooth as butter. This means a more enjoyable experience for everyone, no matter your spec.

[b]*New Levels!*[/b]

Keep making new levels for full version, it takes some time because I want every level to be different so you can have varied experience.

Each level will not only boast different aesthetics but also introduce fresh obstacles and innovative ways to reach the hole. Get ready to think strategically and unleash your inner golfing genius!

I can't wait to share more details about these exciting new levels soon. In the meantime, keep your eyes peeled for more updates!

[b]Let me know in the comments what kind of crazy golf challenges you'd love to see! [/b]

notes.title: DEMO Available now!

Greetings, fellow golfers!
